text: Security is a crucial part of web development. One basic step is using HTTPS, which encrypts data between the user and the server. Authentication also matters: websites should verify who users are before giving access to private information. Another key practice is input validation, which checks the data users submit and blocks harmful content. Developers must also learn about common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting (XSS). These attacks can steal data or damage a website. By combining HTTPS, strong authentication, careful input validation, and awareness of common threats, developers can build safer web applications that protect both users and businesses.
